Bash(# 查看 Stop hooks 详情
cat ~/.claude/settings.json 2>/dev/null | python -c "
import json, sys
data = json.load\(sys.stdin\)
hooks = data.get\('hooks', {}\)
stop_hooks = hooks.get\('Stop', []\)
print\('=== STOP HOOKS ==='\)
for i, hg in enumerate\(stop_hooks\):
    matcher = hg.get\('matcher', '*'\)
    for h in hg.get\('hooks', []\):
        cmd = h.get\('command', ''\)
        timeout = h.get\('timeout', 'default'\)
        print\(f'  [{i+1}] matcher: {matcher}'\)
        print\(f'      command: {cmd[:120]}'\)
        print\(f'      timeout: {timeout}'\)
        print\(\)
" 2>/dev/null)

Bash(# 查看 SessionStart/SessionEnd/PreCompact hooks 详情
cat ~/.claude/settings.json 2>/dev/null | python -c "
import json, sys
data = json.load\(sys.stdin\)
hooks = data.get\('hooks', {}\)
for event in ['SessionStart', 'SessionEnd', 'PreCompact', 'PreToolUse', 'PostToolUse']:
    hook_list = hooks.get\(event, []\)
    if not hook_list:
        continue
    print\(f'=== {event} HOOKS \({len\(hook_list\)}\) ==='\)
    for i, hg in enumerate\(hook_list\):
        matcher = hg.get\('matcher', '*'\)
        for h in hg.get\('hooks', []\):
            cmd = h.get\('command', ''\)
            # 判断来源
            if 'CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT' in cmd:
                source = 'ECC \(env var\)'
            elif 'everything-claude-code' in cmd:
                source = 'ECC \(hardcoded\)'
            elif 'omc' in cmd.lower\(\) or 'oh-my-claudecode' in cmd.lower\(\):
                source = 'OMC'
            else:
                source = 'INLINE'
            print\(f'  [{i+1}] source: {source}'\)
            print\(f'      matcher: {matcher}'\)
            print\(f'      cmd: {cmd[:100]}'\)
            print\(\)
" 2>/dev/null)
